The blocks are forced: Ben–Cara–Dev occupy three consecutive slots, and Hana–Ivo occupy two consecutive slots with Ivo before Cara. Finn must be at least three slots before Hana, so the only placement that still leaves legal slots is Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9 and Hana–Ivo in 5–6, with Finn in 1.

Slots 2–4 then go to Elif, Ann, and Gus. Elif before Ivo, Ann before Gus, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, and Ann at least three slots from Ivo fix that order as Elif, Ann, Gus. Every other block placement breaks at least one constraint.
